risks.title: Impact of technologies on demand for services
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes that automation, AI, and other technologies may improve clients' recruitment efficiency, thereby reducing their need for external services. The strength of language ('reduce the demand for our services', 'negatively affect our business') is notable. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Client dependency and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly states that demand for services is sensitive to economic activity and that clients may exert pricing pressure. The strength of language ('negatively impact our financial condition', 'pricing pressure') and the current economic context justify a high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and liability risks
risks.score_rationale: The document details risks of lawsuits for medical malpractice, privacy violations, labor law, and others. The strength of language ('substantial liabilities', 'significant additional wages', 'sizeable statutory penalties') indicates high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Client concentration risk (Kaiser)
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on a major client (Kaiser, 22% of revenue) is clearly identified as a risk. Losing this client would have a 'material adverse effect on our revenue, results of operations and cash flows'. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Evolution of the healthcare regulatory landscape
risks.score_rationale: The text notes that the healthcare sector is heavily influenced by regulatory changes (ACA, etc.) and that uncertainty or modifications could affect demand. The language is cautious but highlights potential impact ('negatively affect demand', 'operating results'). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impact of health crises and pandemics
risks.score_rationale: Past experience with COVID-19 is cited as an example of negative impact on demand, operations, and costs. The risk of future health crises is explicitly mentioned ('Similar challenges could arise in future public health crises'). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased competition through intermediaries
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates that clients may use intermediaries (GPO, MSP) that increase their bargaining power or develop their own staffing models. This could affect pricing and the ability to retain clients. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: AMN explicitly mentions artificial intelligence and machine learning in its 10-K report as a potential risk factor. The company acknowledges that clients could improve the effectiveness of their recruitment and staffing functions through AI, automation, and other advanced technologies, which could reduce demand for AMN's services.
evidence: Item 1A Risk Factors: 'If our clients are able to increase the effectiveness of their staffing and recruitment functions through analytics, automation, machine learning, artificial intelligence (AI) or other advanced technologies or otherwise increase the effectiveness of their permanent hiring or retention of permanent employees'
